tooSmall.title: Use a computer
tooSmall.body: HueForge needs at least 1366 × 768 pixels. Colours and layers are not workable on a phone or tablet.

light.intensityTip: How brightly the light shines in the preview simulation. Does not affect the print.

mode.tip: A lithophane is backlit, filament painting is viewed from the front.

heights.layerHeightTip: Height of one printed layer in mm. Sets how finely colour can be tuned.
heights.firstLayerHeightTip: Height of the first layer in mm. Usually thicker for bed adhesion.
heights.heightStepTip: How many mm a height changes per arrow key or mouse wheel notch.
heights.notMultiple: Value must be a multiple of the layer height ({{layerHeight}} mm).

preview.label: Preview
preview.noImage: Load an image in the Source image panel and the model appears here.

drop.title: Drop an image here
drop.hint: Or click to pick a file, or paste from the clipboard with Ctrl+V.
drop.failed: That file could not be read.

probe.hint: Click the image to measure brightness and height.

size.widthTip: Width of the finished print in mm.
size.heightTip: Height of the finished print in mm, measured flat on the bed.
size.lockAspectTip: Keeps the loaded image's proportions so it cannot stretch.
size.detailTip: Distance between mesh samples in mm. Smaller means finer detail and more triangles.

border.noneTip: Turns off the flat frame around the image.
border.widthTip: How far the frame reaches in from each edge, in mm.
border.depthTip: Height of the frame in mm. Must be a multiple of the layer height.

depth.baseTip: Solid slab under the relief in mm. Holds the model together at its darkest.
depth.maxTip: Total height at the brightest part of the image, in mm.
depth.dynamicTip: Rounds the max depth to whole layers so the top one is not cut in half.

brightness.srgbTip: Linearises colour before weighting it. Physically correct, but flatter mid-tones.
brightness.compensationTip: Gamma on the result. Below 1 lifts shadows, above 1 deepens them.
brightness.adjustmentTip: Added to every sample, moving the whole relief up or down.
brightness.smoothingTip: Blur radius in pixels. Kills noise and banding, but costs fine detail.
brightness.invertTip: Swaps light and dark. For lithophanes, which print the other way round.
brightness.fullRangeTip: Stretches the darkest and brightest spots across the whole height range.

statusBar.trianglesOverLimit: Triangle count exceeds the limit of {{limit}}.

common.notImplemented: This feature is coming in a later milestone.
